notes.title: Trap welcome to Beryl part 4 available !
notes.notes:
Trap welcome to Beryl part 4 is finally available, come and discover the end of this horrifying adventure!
Good luck to you!

notes.title: Announcement Trap Part 4
notes.notes:
Hello!
I am pleased to announce that the last chapter of "Trap welcome to Beryl" comes out on 08.08.2021, the update will also be accompanied by fixes and changes that were made for the other chapters.
I apologize for this long wait in wishing you good game.

notes.title: Delay exit part 4
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, following the natural disaster in Breil sur Roya, the release of the last part of Trap will unfortunately be postponed, I had planned to release it for Halloween, but circumstances do not allow me.
 In the meantime I would do my best to remedy it.
 Thanks for your understanding.

notes.title: Trap part 4
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32527470/3427b395d00a761749cf624ec918c365318de00b.png[/img]

Hello everyone.
I inform you that Trap Part 4 "Reality" will be available soon.
This chapter will be the last and concludes the story of Trap, currently I can not give you a release date.
But I'm doing my best to sort it out asap.
I take this opportunity to thank you for playing Trap and thank you very much for your comments which motivates me to finish this little project.
See you soon.

notes.title: Trap Part 3 is available today!
notes.notes:
Following a personal constraint I made available to you the part 3 of Trap before the scheduled date, you will just have to download the update of the DLC Trap Part 2.

Good game.

notes.title: Trap Part 3 Release Date: 16/07/2019
notes.notes:
[b]The 3rd Trap Chapter will be added to the DLC "Trap Part 2 Room 6" via an update.[/b]  

Trap Chapter 3 is released on the [b]16/07/2019[/b], to be able to play, it will be enough to buy the DLC of the part 2, this new chapter is the direct continuation of "Trap chapter 2 room 6".  Discover more intrigues with over an hour of game time and many new places, all in pixel art.

This update will contain:

[b]Chapter 2:[/b]
-A new screen resolution.  
-A new look of backup menus and objects.  
-A more fluid game. 

[b]Chapter 3:[/b]
-With a playing time of one hour.  
-Much more scenery and exploration.  
-More riddles.  
-An atmosphere more and more disturbed.  

Hopping  that you like it.

notes.title: Your old backups can not be recovered.
notes.notes:
I'm sorry but due to the new updates, your old backups can not be recovered. Unfortunately you would have to start your game again. I am really sorry.

You must delete your old backups in the Steam / steamapps / common / Trap / www / save / 

No need to delete config.rpgsave and global.rpgsave files
